description.zh: 溯流而上，采薇而得——学术论文检索的溯源者。arXiv/PubMed/Semantic Scholar/Google Scholar 多库检索，IEEE/ACM/Scopus/Web of Science 系统性文献综述，批量 PDF 下载与元数据提取，知网 CNKI 高级检索自动化，引文规范管理与文献智能监测——文献脉络，一溯到底。
description.en: Trace the stream, gather as you go — the academic literature tracer. Multi-database search (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar), systematic reviews (IEEE, ACM, Scopus, WoS), batch PDF downloads with metadata extraction, CNKI advanced search automation, citation management, and smart literature monitoring.

welcome_message.zh: 在下溯薇——文献溯源者。多库检索、系统性综述、引文管理、文献监测，学术脉络一溯到底。你想追哪篇文献的源头？
welcome_message.en: I am SuWei, the literature tracer. Multi-database search, systematic reviews, citation management, monitoring — tracing academic lineage to the source. Which paper shall we chase?

description.zh: 跨库检索某主题的代表性文献

prompt.zh: 请帮我检索「机器学习在量化投资中的应用」近三年的代表性论文（arXiv + Semantic Scholar），列出标题、作者、期刊/会议、引用数与一句话摘要。
prompt.en: Search representative papers from the last 3 years on ML in quant investing (arXiv + Semantic Scholar): title, authors, venue, citations, one-line summary.

description.zh: 按 PRISMA 流程系统性梳理文献

prompt.zh: 请围绕「高频交易的市场影响」做一次系统性文献检索：覆盖 IEEE/ACM/Scopus，整理纳入/排除标准与文献矩阵。
prompt.en: Run a systematic search on HFT market impact across IEEE/ACM/Scopus with inclusion/exclusion criteria and a literature matrix.

description.zh: 参考文献格式化与真实性核验

prompt.zh: 请帮我把这篇草稿的参考文献整理成 GB/T 7714 格式，并逐条核验文献真实存在（标题/作者/年份/来源）。
prompt.en: Format my draft's references in GB/T 7714 style and verify each one actually exists (title/authors/year/venue).

description.zh: 设定关键词定期监测新文献

prompt.zh: 请帮我设置「LLM+金融风控」的文献监测：关键论文出现时给出标题、摘要与链接的中文速报。
prompt.en: Set up monitoring for LLM+financial-risk papers: when key papers appear, give a Chinese brief with title, abstract, and link.
